title: Passage
description: A single leveled reading passage in the ReadCoach content library. Produced by content-curator; consumed by mastery-engineer (passage selection), tutor-logic-engineer (question grounding), and frontend-engineer (reading screen).

grade.description: Target grade band for this passage (scope is grades 1-3)

source.description: Attribution for public-domain source text, or "original" if authored for this project

text.description: Full passage text, plain prose, no markup. Sentence boundaries matter for comprehension question generation.

words.description: Pre-tokenized reference words in reading order, exactly matching `text` split on whitespace/punctuation. This is what the alignment engine (backend/tutor) diffs the live transcript against, so it must be produced deterministically from `text`.

skills.description: Skill ids from the taxonomy (see content/skill_taxonomy.json) that this passage exercises/targets. Must be a non-empty subset of taxonomy skill ids.

primary_skill.description: The single skill id this passage was chosen/written to reinforce most. Used by mastery-engineer's passage-selection rule. Must be included in `skills`.

comprehension_hint_topics.description: Optional: 1-3 short phrases flagging what a literal vs. inferential comprehension question could probe (e.g. "why the fox was hungry"). Advisory only for tutor-logic-engineer's question generation, not authoritative.
